mapper.select: select count(1) from elevator_notice where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into elevator_notice (notice_type, title, content, biz_id, receiver_id, is_read, create_time) values (#{noticeType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizId}, #{receiverId}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.update: update elevator_notice set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
